title: Storage Technical Support
description:
**Company Description** 




**About Sutherland**




 Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
 



 We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market\-leading technology and business process excellence.
 



 We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.
 



 For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.
 



 Sutherland
 *Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Technical Support Engineer** 




*Enterprise Storage Platforms* 




  





**Shift** 
 – 24/7
 



  





**Work Location** 
 – Bangalore, Brookfield office. Cab will be provided to the candidates within 25KM range only.
 



  





**Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
 



  





**Experience** 
 : 2\-7 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high\-touch, mission\-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands\-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.
 



 You will work on real\-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
* Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
* Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
* Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
* Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business\-impacting situations.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
* Maintain high\-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
* Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.



**Required Experience** 



* 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
* Solid track record in customer\-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
* Demonstrated hands\-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.



**Technical Skills** 



* **Storage:** 
 Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols \- FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
* **OS:** 
 Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
* **Virtualization:** 
 Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
* **Networking:** 
 Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* **Diagnostics:** 
 Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer\-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E\-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
* Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
* Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).



**How You Work** 



* You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high\-pressure customer conversations.
* You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
* You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
* You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
* You work well with distributed, cross\-functional teams across time zones.

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Act as the technical and process expert for the IT Help Desk function, supporting analysts with complex incidents, service requests, escalations, and process clarifications. Provide advanced Level 1 / Level 1\.5 support for desktop, laptop, operating system, Office 365, browser, printer, network connectivity, remote access, and standard enterprise application issues. Drive first contact resolution improvement by identifying recurring issues, creating troubleshooting guidance, and mentoring analysts on effective resolution steps. Maintain and improve Knowledge Base articles, SOPs, process documents, call scripts, and troubleshooting guides. Monitor ticket quality, adherence to process, SLA compliance, aged tickets, and critical priority incidents; follow up with analysts and resolver teams as required. Support new hire training, refresher training, floor support, and coaching for Help Desk Analysts. Identify process gaps, tool issues, knowledge gaps, and recurring incident trends; recommend corrective and preventive actions. **TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

Working knowledge of ITIL concepts such as incident management, request fulfillment, escalation management, and knowledge management.

Minimum qualification: Technical diploma or graduate degree. Minimum 4\-6 years of experience in IT Help Desk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or technical support operations. Experience in a 24x7 support model is preferred.

Strong listening, probing, and questioning skills to identify root cause quickly. Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and guidance to analysts. Professional communication style for emails, escalations, outage updates, and stakeholder interactions.

Strong customer service orientation with patience, empathy, ownership, and a positive attitude. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. Ability to work independently and support team members during high\-volume or critical situations. Strong attention to detail in ticket documentation, process adherence, and knowledge updates. **About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

We pride ourselves on our customer\-centric approach, offering support to businesses across various time zones and ensuring help is always available when needed.

We foster a collaborative and supportive environment where team members are encouraged to share insights and innovate solutions to enhance customer satisfaction. Additionally, our team is driven by a commitment to personal and professional growth, with ongoing training and development opportunities to ensure we stay adept with the latest features and updates in our platform.

* A relevant ERP module certification

* Exposure to ERP support inside a regulated, audit\-heavy environment

 HR Screening → Assignment → Technical Round → Manager Round → Culture Fit

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Staff**
 CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This includes managing the CyberArk infrastructure, monitoring system performance, and providing first\-level support to resolve issues related to privileged account management. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles and be eager to learn and grow within the field.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Assist in the administration and maintenance of the CyberArk PAM solution, including the management of safes, platforms, and policies.
* Monitor the health and performance of the CyberArk environment, responding to alerts and notifications in a timely manner.
* Provide first\-level support for issues related to privileged account access, including password checkouts, session management, and account onboarding.
* Participate in the onboarding of new accounts into the CyberArk platform, ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to implement enhancements and updates to the CyberArk infrastructure.
* Document standard operating procedures, system configurations, and incident reports.
* Assist in the development and delivery of CyberArk user training and awareness programs.
* Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and evidence related to CyberArk operations.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest CyberArk features, updates, and industry best practices.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks such as patching, upgrades, and backups of the CyberArk environment


**Preferred Skills:**
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
* Any experience with CyberArk or other PAM solutions is beneficial but not required.
* Certifications such as CyberArk Defender or Sentry are desirable but not mandatory for entry\-level applicants


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

title: SharePoint Support Specialist [T500-29192]
description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a SharePoint Support Specialist at Stolt\-Nielsen, you will be the first point of contact for SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, providing responsive P1 and P2 support and ensuring the platform runs smoothly day to day. You will manage site provisioning, permissions, lifecycle management, and the integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.
 



 This role combines operational support with hands\-on administration, and requires strong problem\-solving ability and clear communication, since you will frequently be the one translating technical permission structures into plain language for end users and stakeholders. You will handle site creation and decommissioning, manage permissions and access reviews across multiple levels of the SharePoint and OneDrive environment, execute lifecycle management tasks (inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, archival), and support minor customization requests.
 



 You will work within a small, focused SharePoint team alongside a Team Lead and Senior Developer, with real opportunity to improve your technical skills over time.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Provide P1 and P2 support for all SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, acting as the first point of contact for end users.
* Manage day\-to\-day site provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning in line with governance policies.
* Administer permissions across all levels of the environment, including:
* Site\-level and sub\-site permissions
* Ownership assignment and transfer
* Guest\-level (external user) permissions and access reviews
* Folder\- and item\-level (unique) permissions
* OneDrive\-level sharing and access permissions
* Security group membership and Microsoft 365 group permissions
* Diagnose and resolve permission\-related issues logically and systematically, tracing access problems back to their root cause (e.g. broken inheritance, conflicting group membership, expired guest access) rather than applying quick fixes.
* Execute lifecycle management tasks including inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, and archival processes.
* Support integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications such as Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Viva Engage.
* Log, track, and report on support tickets; maintain SLA compliance and provide regular reporting on ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with end users and stakeholders — explaining permission issues, timelines, and resolutions in an accessible, non\-technical way.
* Handle minor customisation requests such as page layouts, list configurations, and basic workflow adjustments.
* Assist with permission audits and access reviews in support of governance and compliance requirements.
* Maintain clear, well\-structured documentation for support procedures, known issues, permission models, and environment configurations.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in SharePoint Online administration within a Microsoft 365 enterprise environment.
* Strong, demonstrable understanding of SharePoint's permission model, including site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest, and OneDrive permissions, and how inheritance and breaking inheritance affects access.
* Solid understanding of security groups and access management.
* Experience with site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration (Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Viva Engage).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for administrative tasks and bulk operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking skills, with the ability to methodically diagnose and resolve complex access and permission issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong service orientation with excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritise effectively, and work under SLA pressure.
* Attention to detail and commitment to thorough documentation.



  





**Must\-Have Skills:** 



* SharePoint Online administration and site management
* In\-depth knowledge of SharePoint permissions: site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest access, and ownership management
* OneDrive permissions and sharing management
* Microsoft 365 permissions management and security groups
* Site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance
* Incident management and SLA\-driven support
* Basic PowerShell scripting
* Strong problem\-solving and logical/analytical thinking
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Experience with Power Automate for basic workflow automation
* Familiarity with SharePoint migration processes
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other compliance and governance tools
* Experience with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar)
* Exposure to Power Apps or SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development

description:

 We are recruiting a Senior Platform Engineer to own the health, performance and evolution of the global OutSystems platform at Stolt\-Nielsen (SN).
 



 This is deliberately an operations\-first role. Around 80% of your week will be spent keeping our environments running well – monitoring, incident response, deployments, upgrades, access management and performance tuning. The remaining 20% is hands\-on development: the automation, tooling and platform components that make the operational work faster and less manual, plus occasional support to delivery teams on technical problems.
 



 If you enjoy owning a platform end to end and would rather automate a problem than repeat a workaround, this role is built for you.
 



 We take digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring, and we give them the tools to work in a modern way. As we build up our engineering practice further, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape our ways of working and technology landscape.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




**Platform support and operations (80%)** 




**Environment administration:** 



* Administer and maintain our OutSystems environments across Development, Test, Acceptance and Production.
* Manage configuration, environment setup and system resources across cloud and on\-premises installations.
* Manage user roles, permissions and access controls in line with our security policies.



  





**Application lifecycle management:** 



* Run deployments, tagging, versioning and rollbacks through OutSystems Lifetime.
* Guard our ALM standards and manage dependencies so that releases stay predictable.
* Support new teams onboarding onto the platform so they can deliver reliably from the start.



  





**Monitoring and performance:** 



* Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting for availability, performance and errors.
* Monitor and optimise platform performance, database usage and environment capacity.
* Identify capacity constraints before they become incidents, and plan accordingly.



  





**Incident and problem management:** 



* Act as the escalation point for platform\-related issues, coordinating with OutSystems Support where needed.
* Lead root cause analysis and drive preventive maintenance so the same incident does not recur.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to a standard others can actually follow.



  





**Upgrades and maintenance:** 



* Plan, perform and document platform upgrades, patches and scheduled maintenance, working with our development and infrastructure teams.
* Oversee database management on SQL Server, including backups, schema evolution and performance tuning.



  





**Development and automation (20%):** 



* Build automation that removes manual operational steps, deployment scripts, health checks, environment provisioning, routine reporting.
* Integrate OutSystems into our CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps team.
* Develop and maintain reusable platform components, integrations and shared services used across applications.
* Provide hands\-on technical support to OutSystems developers on integration, performance and architecture questions.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and help define our operational standards for low\-code environments.



  





**What you'll bring:** 



* Proven experience managing OutSystems platforms in an enterprise, multi\-environment setup.
* Strong understanding of OutSystems architecture across front\-end, service and integration layers.
* Working knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime, Service Center, Integration Studio and the Infrastructure Management Console.
* Practical database administration experience\-Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or similar.
* Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, PaaS components and network and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD tooling and automation scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Excellent documentation skills and a genuine eye for operational detail.
* The ability to work with developers, infrastructure teams and security specialists to keep the platform healthy and aligned with our wider goals.



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* 5\+ years in IT operations, platform administration or DevOps roles.
* 3\+ years of OutSystems platform administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime and environment management.
* Database management on SQL Server or Oracle.
* Platform monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of OutSystems ALM, deployment flows and dependency management.
* Familiarity with networking, firewalls and identity management using Azure AD or Entra ID.



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Scripting for operational automation at scale, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Experience introducing monitoring or observability tooling to a platform that lacked it.
* Exposure to OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC).
* Experience supporting a geographically distributed user base across time zones.



  





**How we'll measure success:** 



* Our environments are stable, and unplanned downtime is rare and short.
* Deployments are routine and low\-drama, following a consistent ALM process.
* Recurring manual tasks reduce over time because they have been automated away.
* Platform documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up an incident without you.

description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity**


We are now looking for a **Service Monitoring Engineer** to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through jeopardy management of the incidents.  

You will play a key role in tracking, and driving timely closure of incidents, service requests, and operational tasks to ensure network availability is maintained at the target levels. This will require coordination with the Field, 3PP \& Internal Ericsson team. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericsson’s vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.

 **What you will do**

* Continuously track incidents, service tickets, and operational activities.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with responsible teams to ensure progress towards timely closure.
* Initiate recovery actions when timelines slip or risk indicators arise.
* Validate updates and ensure all incidents have clear actions, owners, and deadlines.
* Responsible for delivering the necessary reports required for the Jeopardy Management of the incidents \& as defined and requested by customer.
* Apply the defined escalation matrix based on severity, impact, and aging of incidents.
* Ensure adherence to jeopardy management policies, workflows, and SLAs.
* Provide regular status updates to stakeholders regarding jeopardy items and escalated issues.
* Prepare incident summary reports, escalation logs, and closure metrics for leadership review.
* Track and report KPIs such as aging incidents, SLA compliance, escalation count, and closure rate \& blockers/reasons for slow progression.
* Maintain dashboards or trackers that highlight jeopardy status and follow\-up progress.
* Support audit requirements with proper documentation and data accuracy.
* Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to reduce incident occurrence and impact.

 **The skills you bring**

* 2–6 years of experience in Network Operations / Alarm Monitoring in a telecom or IT network environment.
* Strong understanding of general network technologies and concepts across access, transport, and IP domains (vendor\-agnostic).
* Hands\-on experience with Ericsson OSS/NMS tools or other multi\-vendor management systems (e.g., Netcool, HP OpenView, SolarWinds, etc.).
* Knowledge of fault management processes, ITIL best practices, and SLA\-driven operational models.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to quickly interpret incidents and determine probable actions needed to resolve the same.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective collaboration across global teams.
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Skilled in handling escalations and managing political dynamics in high\-stakes scenarios.
* Hands on analytical tools like MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Power Bi.
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift environment (rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays).
* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.

 **All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification**

 Release Management

 Build and maintain deployment tools/procedures
   

  

 Zero downtime deployments and a high availability mindset
   

  

 Define and build innovative solution methodologies and assets around infrastructure, cloud migration and deployment operations at scale.
   

  

 Work with service teams to resolve complex issues that require troubleshooting and knowledge of code.
   

  

 Keep documentation up to date and resolving similar tickets with lower turnaround time and within SLA
   

  

 Ensure production security posture
   

  

 Ensure monitoring is robust and effective
   

  

 Change Management
   

  

 Perform Root Cause Analysis
   

  

 Required Skills:
   

  

 5\+ years overall experience in IT industry
   

  

**Minimum 4 Years Of Experience As a Sys Admin/Support**
 Strong systems architecture skills

 Virtualisation Technologies
   

  

 Scripting Language (Python/Bash/Shell etc, basic understanding of Java / Go will be good to have)
   

  

 Understanding of Networking, Cloud Computing, Load Balancers

title: Trading Desk IT Support Engineer (L2 / L2+)
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------


Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading IT Infrastructure and Digital Transformation company with over 36 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Mumbai, Swan is a ₹1,400\+ Crore organization delivering IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, Virtualization, Storage, and Managed Services to leading enterprise customers.


Swan is a technology partner with leading organizations including HP, Cisco, Microsoft, VMware, and NetApp.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an experienced **Trading Desk IT Support Engineer (L2 / L2\+)** to support mission\-critical trading applications in a live market environment. The role involves proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, production support, and ensuring minimal downtime for critical trading operations.


**Location:** Worli, Mumbai – Client Site
  

**Industry:** BFSI / Capital Markets
  

**Experience:** 4–6 Years
  

**Employment Type:** Full Time / Contract


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Provide L2 support for trading applications including **Omnesys (NEST), NEAT, BOLT, and Greek**.
* Manage and troubleshoot **FIX connectivity and related issues**.
* Perform **EOD/BOD activities** for trading applications and risk management tools.
* Handle critical production issues during live market hours with minimal downtime.
* Deploy patches and upgrades across UAT and Production environments.
* Install, configure, and maintain servers supporting trading applications.
* Support infrastructure at **NSE, BSE, and MCX Colo Data Centers**.
* Manage **Active Directory, user access, and permissions**.
* Monitor trading networks and support low\-latency infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for issue resolution and technical escalations.
* Perform daily backup activities and ensure security compliance.
* Support **Bloomberg terminals** and other trading\-related applications.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Strong experience in a **Trading / Capital Markets environment**.
* Hands\-on experience with **NEST / NEAT / BOLT** or similar trading applications.
* Strong knowledge of **FIX Protocol and connectivity**.
* Proven experience in **L2 Production Support**.

title: Manager, Help Desk
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
 Scale Computing is a global leader in edge computing, hyperconverged infrastructure, and managed networking solutions. We deliver innovative, secure, and scalable technology that powers critical operations worldwide.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Help Desk Manager is responsible for the overall operational health of Scale Computing's IT systems and the leadership of the Help Desk/System Administration team in India as well as fostering open communications with the US Help Desk/System Administration counterparts. This position's primary focus is on people management, process optimization, and service delivery. While management is the core of your day\-to\-day, you will maintain a technical edge, acting as a point of escalation for complex issues that require expert intervention.
   

  

 You will manage the lifecycle of IT tickets, ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), oversee critical infrastructure (Systems/Network), and drive the professional development of your direct reports. The ideal candidate is a seasoned IT leader who can balance high\-level technical strategy with day\-to\-day operational excellence.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
 Operational Leadership: Manage the daily operations of the IT Helpdesk and Systems Administration functions, ensuring 24/7 (coordinating with the US Manager/Teams) coverage and rapid resolution of incidents.
   

  

 People Management: Recruit, train, coach, and conduct performance reviews for a blended team of SysAdmins and Helpdesk technicians.
   

  

 Strategic Planning: Assist senior leadership in planning IT budgets, resource allocation, and technology roadmaps.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Management


 Lead, coach, and manage a team of Systems Administrators and Helpdesk Support staff.
   

  

 Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, and career development planning for direct reports.
   

  

 Manage staff scheduling, on\-call rotations, and resource allocation to ensure coverage during critical business hours.
   

  

 Foster a culture of accountability, internal customer service excellence, and continuous learning.
   

  

* Helpdesk \& Service Delivery


 SLA Management: Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times using Jira Service Management.
   

  

 Incident Management: Serve as the primary point of escalation for high\-priority or complex technical issues that the team cannot resolve.
   

  

 Trend Analysis: Analyze ticket data to identify recurring issues and implement root\-cause fixes to reduce ticket volume.
   

  

 Onboarding: Oversee the "New Hire" process to ensure first\-day productivity for new employees (hardware, accounts, access).
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Systems Oversight


 System Governance: Oversee the administration of core enterprise systems, including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Dialpad, and Atlassian Suite (Jira/Confluence).
   

  

 Network Strategy: Supervise the health of the network infrastructure (Fortinet firewalls, switches, routers), ensuring the team performs timely firmware updates and security patching.
   

  

 Asset Management: Manage IT asset lifecycle (procurement, inventory tracking, and retirement) for the India office and remote workforce.
   

  

* Security \& Compliance


 Policy Enforcement: Ensure all IT operations comply with internal security policies and external frameworks (PCI\-DSS, CIS Controls, SOC2\).
   

  

 Audit Readiness: Collaborate with the Information Security team to maintain documentation and evidence for security audits.
   

  

 Risk Management: Proactively identify risks in the IT environment and propose mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Success Metrics for the Role**
 Team Performance: High retention rates and positive feedback on team performance reviews.
   

  

 Operational Efficiency: Consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs for helpdesk ticket resolution.
   

  

 System Uptime: Maintenance of 99\.9% uptime for core internal systems and network infrastructure.
   

  

 Project Delivery: Successful oversight of completion of IT infrastructure projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Required Education and Experience:**
 Experience: 8\+ years of total IT experience, with at least 3\+ years in a people management or team lead role (managing performance, hiring, etc.).
   

  

 Technical Background: Strong background in Systems Administration (Linux, Windows, macOS) and Networking. You must be technical enough to validate your team's work.
   

  

 Process Knowledge: Demonstrated experience with ITIL frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
   

  

 Tools: Proficiency in modern IT management stacks, specifically JumpCloud, Jira Service Management, and Google Workspace.
   

  

 Language: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are mandatory for cross\-region collaboration.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
   

  

 Certifications: ITIL Foundation/Practitioner, PMP (Project Management Professional), or technical certs like CISSP/CISM or Fortinet NSE.
   

  

 Experience managing vendors and procurement processes in India.
   

  

**Working Conditions \& Physical Demands**
 Position Type: Full\-Time, In\-Office/Hybrid
   

  

 Hours of Work: Standard business hours (7am\-4pm IST, 2pm\-11pm IST) to overlap with US operations, with flexibility required for critical escalations.
   

  

 Physical Demands: Primarily sedentary; may require oversight of physical equipment setup.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Group medical insurance
* Casual dress code
* Hybrid work schedule
* Paid company holidays
* Cab facilities
* Fully stocked snacks at office
* Vibrant and inclusive workplace atmosphere
* Flexible work environment with growth opportunities


 Scale Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Final candidates will be subject to a pre\-employment background check

You will act as a subject matter expert, guiding junior team members, driving resolution for escalated cases, and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.

 At Kuehne\+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:

 IT / Infrastructure Support
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Technical IT Support Engineer with 6 to 9 years of strong end\-to\-end IT support experience. This role is ideal for someone who has worked across modern IT environments and is comfortable supporting users, systems, tools, cloud platforms, networks, and business applications in a fast\-paced setup.
 



 The person should have in\-depth experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows, Linux, Networking, Endpoint Support, Security Basics, and AI\-enabled productivity tools. The role requires someone who can troubleshoot quickly, communicate clearly, and support both day\-to\-day IT operations and continuous improvement initiatives.
 



 This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, supporting users, improving processes, and working with multiple technologies in a dynamic environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**IT Support \& User Management** 




 · Provide hands\-on technical support for end users across hardware, software, network, and application\-related issues.
 



 · Manage user accounts, access requests, permissions, groups, licenses, and basic identity\-related troubleshooting.
 



 · Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including device setup, application access, and system readiness.
 



 · Troubleshoot issues related to laptops, desktops, printers, VPN, Wi\-Fi, email, Teams, and business applications.
 



 · Ensure tickets are handled within agreed timelines while maintaining a strong user experience.
 



  





**Microsoft 365, Azure \& Cloud Support** 




 · Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange Online, and basic admin activities.
 



 · Assist with Azure\-related support including user access, basic cloud administration, identity management, and troubleshooting.
 



 · Work with Intune or endpoint management tools for device compliance, configuration, and application deployment.
 



 · Support security and access controls such as MFA, password resets, conditional access basics, and account protection.
 



 · Help users adopt M365 and AI\-based tools effectively to improve productivity.
 



  





**Infrastructure, Networking \& Systems Support** 




 · Troubleshoot network\-related issues including LAN, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, firewalls, and connectivity problems.
 



 · Provide support across Windows and Linux environments, including installation, configuration, patching, and basic administration.
 



 · Monitor and support endpoint performance, system availability, and common infrastructure issues.
 



 · Assist with backup checks, asset tracking, inventory management, and IT documentation.
 



 · Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
 



  





**AI Tools, Automation \& Process Improvement** 




 · Support and guide users on AI productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot or similar AI\-enabled workplace tools.
 



 · Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT support tasks and improve service efficiency.
 



 · Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
 



 · Contribute to IT improvement projects, system upgrades, migrations, and new tool rollouts.
 



 · Stay updated with emerging technologies and bring practical ideas to improve internal IT operations.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  





 These must already be established and not skills to be developed in the role.
 



 · 6 to 9 years of hands\-on experience in IT support, infrastructure support, or technical support roles.
 



 · Strong experience supporting Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online.
 



 · Practical experience with Azure, Entra ID / Azure AD, user access management, MFA, and basic cloud administration.
 



 · Strong troubleshooting experience across Windows desktop/server environments.
 



 · Good working knowledge of Linux systems and basic command\-line troubleshooting.
 



 · Solid understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, and firewall basics.
 



 · Experience supporting endpoint devices, laptops, desktops, printers, peripherals, and remote users.
 



 · Familiarity with ITSM tools, ticketing systems, SLA management, and incident/request handling.
 



 · Experience working with AI tools, automation tools, or modern workplace productivity platforms.
 



 · Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities and quick turnaround expectations.
 



 · Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users.
 



 · Good documentation skills and experience maintaining support guides, asset records, and process documents.
 



 · Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
 



  





**Desirable Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 · ITIL Foundation certification or good understanding of IT service management practices.
 



 · Microsoft certifications related to M365, Azure, Endpoint, or Security.
 



 · Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, Autopilot, or endpoint management platforms.
 



 · Experience with PowerShell scripting or basic automation.
 



 · Exposure to cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and compliance.
 



 · Experience supporting global users or working in a multi\-location environment.
 



 · Knowledge of backup tools, monitoring tools, and remote support platforms.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just close tickets but actively improves how IT support is delivered. If you have strong technical depth, hands\-on troubleshooting experience, and the ability to support users across Microsoft 365, Azure, AI tools, networking, Linux, and Windows in a fast\-paced environment, we would like to hear from you.

 As the world’s leading multidisciplinary service provider, Deluxe underpins the media and entertainment industry, servicing content creators and distributors including Netflix, WarnerMedia, The Walt Disney Company, Amazon, Apple, Viacom, NBCU, Google, AT\&T and many others, by providing Global Content Distribution, Localization, Accessibility and Mastering while leading end\-to\-end innovation with unparalleled scale and agility across the Streaming, Theatrical, Broadcast and Mobile landscapes.  **www.bydeluxe.com**

 The Domestic Support Technician is in place to respond professionally and timely to all requests, inquiries and issues presented by exhibitor clients (theatres), motion picture studios, and all other callers contacting Deluxe Cinema Support. * Understanding of basic networking technologies such as TCP/IP, FTP, multicast, etc. is a plus.

* Strong customer service skills focused on problem solving and customer satisfaction.

title: System Administrator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **System Administrator** to manage, configure, and continuously improve an enterprise platform based on customer and business requirements.

The role involves **user access management, system configuration, module administration, workflow automation, dashboards, issue management, and customer coordination**. You will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to implement approved requests, resolve system\-related issues, and ensure the platform operates efficiently.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, SaaS, or similar business platform**, along with strong communication, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and configuration skills.

Key Responsibilities

User Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts based on approved requests.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and access levels.
* Maintain accurate access controls and system governance.
* Ensure access requests are completed accurately and within required timelines.

Customer Communication \& Issue Management

* Communicate system performance issues, service updates, and system changes to customers.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders during system\-related issues.
* Provide clear updates on issue status, resolution progress, and planned improvements.
* Track customer questions and requests through to completion.

Feature Requests \& System Improvements

* Review customer suggestions, enhancement requests, and system feedback.
* Work with internal stakeholders to assess the feasibility of requested changes.
* Implement approved configuration changes based on customer requirements.
* Communicate decisions, timelines, and progress to customers.
* Identify opportunities to improve system usability and operational efficiency.

Module Administration

Manage customer requests and configurations across various platform modules, including:

* Locations and Provider Assignments
* Asset Management
* Refrigerant Tracking
* Site Planning
* Inventory Management
* Supply Manager Administration
* Planned Maintenance

Process Configuration \& Optimization

* Update business hours and user/location\-level settings.
* Configure multi\-level invoice and proposal approval processes.
* Implement automated invoice approval workflows.
* Review existing workflows and identify opportunities for simplification and automation.
* Ensure configuration changes meet customer requirements and business processes.

Dashboard \& System Configuration

* Configure dashboards based on customer reporting and operational requirements.
* Manage issue\-list settings for accurate issue tracking and resolution.
* Maintain configuration consistency and data accuracy across the platform.
* Test configuration changes before implementation.
* Document important system and configuration changes.

Required Qualifications

* **4\+ years of experience** in System Administration, Platform Administration, Application Administration, SaaS Administration, or similar roles.
* Hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, or business operations platform**.
* Experience managing user accounts, roles, permissions, and system configurations.
* Strong understanding of system configuration and workflow management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple customer requests and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **Facilities Management (FM)** or **Work Order Management** platforms.
* Knowledge of **invoices, proposals, planned maintenance, assets, inventory, locations, and provider management**.
* Experience configuring **dashboards, workflows, approval processes, and automation**.
* Familiarity with **issue tracking, system testing, and configuration documentation**.
* Experience working with **SaaS or enterprise applications**.
* Exposure to customer support or technical/application support environments is an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of **system administration**, understand customer requirements, implement configurations accurately, troubleshoot system\-related issues, and proactively identify opportunities to improve platform processes and operational efficiency.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4\+ Years  
**Work Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you supported US clients? Are you comfortable working the required US shift?
* How have you managed users, roles, permissions, and access provisioning?

* Which enterprise/SaaS, Facilities Management, Work Order Management, or business platform have you administered? What were your key responsibilities?
* Describe your experience with system configuration, workflows, approval processes, or automation.

title: IT Support Associate
description:
**Company Overview**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. Within just three year of inception, we have grown into a close\-knit family of 500\+ employees, each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency \& deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging tech Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise lie in Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance and Supply Chain services. We strongly aspire to venture into IOT, AI/ML \& Virtual Reality. Metayb endeavours to be best\-in class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a motivated
 **IT Support Associate** 
 to provide day\-to\-day technical assistance to employees and support the organization's IT infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and user\-access issues while maintaining proper IT documentation and asset records.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide first\-level support for laptops, desktops, printers, applications, and peripherals.
* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, Internet, DNS, and DHCP issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain operating systems and approved software.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, account setup, and IT equipment allocation.
* Manage and update IT support tickets and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and documentation.
* Assist with network devices, Microsoft 365, IP phones, CCTV, attendance systems, and other IT infrastructure.
* Escalate complex issues to senior IT personnel or vendors.
* Follow IT policies, SOPs, security practices, and support procedures.


**Skills Required**
* Good knowledge of Windows 10/11 and computer hardware.
* Basic understanding of networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/Wi\-Fi, and VPN.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365\.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and customer service skills.
* Good documentation and organizational skills.


**Disclaimer:** 
 The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.

title: Sr. Salesforce Support Engineer
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Summary**
 Genesys is looking for an experienced Salesforce Support technical resource with expertise in supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud applications. This is a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment requiring strong technical troubleshooting, customer support, and operational skills.
   

  

 The role will focus on providing production support, maintaining system stability, supporting business users globally, and collaborating with development teams to support ongoing application enhancements and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide production support and administration for Salesforce CRM applications and related integrations.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve application, data, and user issues in a timely manner.
   

  

 Configure and maintain Salesforce users, roles, profiles, security, workflows, reports, dashboards, and customizations.
   

  

 Support data management activities including data imports, validation, and integrity monitoring.
   

  

 Debug issues related to Apex, Flows, Workflows, integrations, and automation components.
   

  

 Collaborate with development and cross\-functional teams to resolve incidents and support releases.
   

  

 Identify recurring issues and drive process improvements and automation opportunities.
   

  

 Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
   

  

 Support AI\-enabled operational workflows and automation initiatives where applicable.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
 6\+ years of experience in Salesforce Administration, Application Support, or Production Support.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud.
   

  

 Good understanding of Salesforce security model, users, roles, profiles, sharing rules, and data management.
   

  

 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Experience with SOQL, Data Loader, Apex debugging, Flows, and Workflows.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Salesforce reports, dashboards, and CRM processes.
   

  

 Experience with integrations, REST/SOAP APIs, and enterprise applications.
   

  

 Strong communication, customer support, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Good understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management) Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced support environment. Experience or exposure to Agentic AI, AI\-driven automation, copilots, or AI\-assisted operational workflows is desirable.
   

  

**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
   

  

**What Happens After You Apply**
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
   

  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps


 Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
   

  

**Stay Connected**
 Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
   

  

 Get notified about relevant opportunities.
   

  

**Be the one building what's next \- where AI, experience and impact come together.**
**Employee Referral**
 If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.
   

  

**About Genesys:**
 Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built\-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:**
 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com.
   

  

 You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre\-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.
   

  

 This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow\-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.
   

  

**Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.**
*Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.*

title: Linux Administration_94357
description:

**Roles and Responsibilities:**



* Provide 24x7 operational support for all Staples Cloud Infrastructure and participate in the on\-call rotation.
* Implement infrastructure availability and performance monitoring to ensure platform uptime and performance.
* Automate OS/security patching, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster upgrades, etc.

* Develop, maintain, and promote a culture of continuous enhancement for a robust knowledge management system for the Cloud Services team and its partners.
* Collaborate with Cloud Engineers/Architects, SRE, Development, Release Engineering, and Database teams to support implementations into the cloud infrastructure.

* Must be proficient in automation tools including Ansible, Chef, Jenkins, and Terraform.
* Must have experience working with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Must have strong Linux system\-level knowledge including shell scripting, systemd, and OS\-level troubleshooting.
* Must have working knowledge of API integrations using REST/JSON and WebSockets.
* Must have scripting experience using Bash and basic knowledge of Perl.
* Should have basic exposure to Kubernetes administration and cloud\-native environments.
* Should possess AZ\-104: Azure Administrator certification or equivalent practical experience.



**Education:**
 Relevant degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: Senior Service Engineer
description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. title: Senior IT Administrator (Global)
description:
Role: Senior IT Administrator (Global)  

  

About Us:  

  

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend\-to\-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence  

accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that  

organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business  

decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows  

to read, understand, and make real\-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading  

to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises,  

including one\-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen's invoice, expense, and card transaction  

solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their  

businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.  

  

About the Role:  

  

As a Senior IT Administrator (Global), you will work closely with the rest of our team to ensure  

that our company is using the most up\-to\-date technology to run our business. We are seeking  

a hands\-on IT administrator who will own the day\-to\-day reliability, security, and scalability of  

our hardware, software, and internal network, while directly supporting our staff across global  

offices.  

  

Roles and Responsibilities:  

  

* Administer, maintain, and support the company's IT infrastructure (network, endpoints,


servers, cloud accounts) across global offices.  

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations, ensuring 24x7 availability and reliability of systems


and services.  

* Own the user onboarding and offboarding process, including access provisioning and


deprovisioning across systems.  

* Administer SaaS applications — user provisioning, license tracking, and renewal


coordination.  

* Execute the IT asset life cycle end\-to\-end: procurement, deployment, tracking, and


secure disposal.  

* Monitor systems and infrastructure proactively; troubleshoot, resolve, and escalate


incidents within SLA.  

* Support the CISO/security function on day\-to\-day compliance tasks, security tooling


configuration, and audit evidence gathering.  

* Identify repetitive manual tasks and build automation (Shell/Python scripting, API


integrations) to streamline IT operations.  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support integration projects and resolve


tooling gaps.  

* Maintain and enforce existing IT policies and procedures; flag gaps for review.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery execution — testing, documentation,


and runbook upkeep.  

* Act as the escalation point for Tier 2/3 technical support and helpdesk operations.


Senior IT Administrator (Global) \| Confidential  

AppZen – Senior IT Administrator (Global) JD  

* Document processes, configurations, and runbooks to build team knowledge and reduce


single points of failure.  

* Coordinate with vendors on day\-to\-day support tickets, renewals, and issue resolution.
* Mentor junior IT staff and interns on troubleshooting approach and best practices.
* Track IT performance metrics (uptime, ticket resolution time, SLA adherence) and report


on trends.  

  

Experience and Qualifications:  

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 2\-6 years of hands\-on experience administering IT infrastructure and operations;


experience in a global, multi\-office, or distributed\-team environment preferred.  

* Strong working knowledge of network administration, endpoint management, and SaaS


application administration.  

* Practical experience with automation/scripting (Shell, Python) to streamline recurring IT


tasks.  

* Comfortable working in a startup/scale\-up environment. This role will require occasional


overlap with US/UK time zones.  

* Working knowledge of ITIL\-aligned support processes (incident, change, and problem


management).  

* Hands\-on experience integrating applications via APIs.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to support end users and collaborate across


cross\-functional teams.  

* Prior experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and tickets simultaneously.


Technologies:  

* Hardware: Cisco Meraki Network Infra, Apple Devices, Windows, IoT thin clients, AV


Equipment, Printers  

* Operating Systems: MacOS, Windows, iOS, and Linux
* Platforms \& Tools: Google Suite, JumpCloud or similar, Jira, OpsGenie, Bitbucket,


Confluence, Jenkins, Zoom Admin, Slack Admin, AWS EC2 and S3, MySQL or  

PostgreSQL, GitHub, Postman, working knowledge of using and integrating APIs, ITIL  

methodology, Shell and Python scripting, etc.  

  

Please share your updated resume on: \[email protected]
We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.

title: Service Executive
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a customer\-focused
 **Service Executive** 
 to act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers and dealers of the respective brand. The ideal candidate will manage end\-to\-end service communication product pickup/drop, case status updates, credit notes, and replacement/repair status while coordinating closely with service technicians to ensure priority repairs are handled on time. This role requires strong communication skills across email, phone (inbound/outbound), and CRM systems (Zoho).
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





**Customer \& Dealer Communication (SPOC)** 



* Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers and dealers of the respective brand for all service\-related communication.
* Keep customers/dealers updated on product pickup and drop schedules and delivery status.
* Communicate case status updates, replacement/repair status, and resolution timelines clearly and proactively.
* Coordinate and communicate credit note status and processing updates to customers/dealers.
* Handle customer/dealer queries and concerns professionally, ensuring high satisfaction levels.



  





**Case \& System Management** 



* Update product pickup/drop, case status, credit notes, and replacement/repair status accurately and in a timely manner in the CRM system.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all customer/dealer interactions in Zoho CRM.
* Track open cases end\-to\-end and ensure timely closure without delays.



  





**Coordination with Technicians** 



* Coordinate with service technicians for priority and escalated repairs to ensure timely turnaround.
* Follow up with the technical team on repair progress and relay accurate updates to customers/dealers.
* Flag delays or bottlenecks in repair status to the Service Manager for quick resolution.



  





**Calls \& Email Handling**

title: Tower Lead - ServiceNow
description:
**Hello,**

 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**

**Summary**
 The ServiceNow Tower Lead is the assistant team leader for the ETS ServiceNow team, responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of ITSM support, project engineering, and platform maintenance, based in the Global Capability Centre. The Tower Lead operates with a high degree of independence, owning solution design and delivery for standard BAU and ITSM work, and coordinating with onshore design leads for major or complex projects where additional design authority is required.
   

  

 Operating within the SIAM framework as part of an internal service provider function, the Tower Lead enables the offshore team to function as a capable, self\-directing delivery unit — maintaining quality, throughput, and platform standards with little routine onshore dependency. The Tower Lead is a senior technical practitioner who leads by example, uplifts team capability, and holds full delivery accountability within the offshore context.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
**Offshore Delivery Leadership**
* Lead and coordinate the offshore ServiceNow development team across BAU support, project delivery, and platform maintenance workstreams.
* Manage daily stand\-ups, sprint ceremonies, and team workflow, driving a high\-performing delivery cadence with minimal onshore direction required.
* Act as the primary escalation point for the development team, resolving blockers and maintaining momentum through active, technically\-grounded leadership.
* Allocate work across the development team based on capacity, skillset, and priority, optimising throughput without compromising quality.
* Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement within the team, setting clear expectations for delivery standards and individual accountability.


**Solution Design and Technical Authority**
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for all BAU ITSM work and small projects, translating business requirements into well\-defined technical specifications and acceptance criteria without requiring onshore input (except where a Technical Business Analyst is also assigned).
* Engage with internal business customers to understand requirements, conduct discovery, and propose fit\-for\-purpose ServiceNow solutions aligned to platform best practices and FCTG standards.
* For major or complex projects, receive design artefacts and functional specifications from design leads, interpret these accurately, and direct the team in executing against the agreed design.


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
**BAU Support Coordination**
* Oversee the offshore team's response to BAU ServiceNow support tickets, ensuring SLA adherence and customer experience standards are maintained independently of onshore involvement.
* Triage incoming support requests, assign to appropriate developers, and track resolution to closure.
* Identify recurring issues or systemic defects and initiate remediation or platform improvement actions within the team's remit, escalating only where broader platform decisions are needed.
* Maintain awareness of platform incidents and manage support team contribution to resolution activities.


**Testing and Release Coordination**
* Oversee the QA function and ensure test plans, test cases, and defect tracking align to agreed acceptance criteria and standards.
* Coordinate release packaging and submission through ETS change management processes, ensuring all governance requirements are met prior to deployment.
* Ensure all release artefacts, documentation, and post\-release validation activities are completed to standard.


**Governance and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate sprint and delivery reporting to support visibility of the team's productivity, quality, and capacity.
* Contribute to standards, documentation, and knowledge base maintenance in Confluence, ServiceNow and Sharepoint.
* Adhere to change management, release, and governance processes as defined by FCTG, ensuring relevant activity is auditable and compliant.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

title: IT Support Associate, IT Services Variable
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Helpdesk is the first place for Amazon employees to go with technical questions and problems with Amazon's desktops, laptops, mobile devices, network services and software. The Amazon Helpdesk works with Amazon and Amazon service managers and other staff to maintain internal solutions and respond to employees’ technical issues. Additionally, they manage all the on\-premise infrastructure including servers, network device, telephony and printers.
   

  

 Amazon.com is looking for a dynamic and motivated IT Support Engineer to join their IT Services Team. If you are customer\-focused with strong problem\-solving skills and have experience with Chrome OS and Windows environments, we want to talk with you.
   

  

 As a member of the team you will have the opportunity to develop your career by maintaining and supporting Amazon’s unique corporate infrastructure, service platforms and employees. This is a challenging role that demands strong communication skills, technical, analytical and problem\-solving competencies and most importantly, customer obsession.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Provide ticket\-based, walk\-up and remote Helpdesk support for Amazon’s growing multi\-site user base and environments.
* Direct internal and external service provider engagements, as needed, in the processing of support requests for effective and timely resolution of issues.
* Manage various routine processes such as new hire onboards, computer life cycle management, asset management, computer imaging, hardware warranty support and hardware recycling.
* Participate in the development, implementation and administration of processes and procedures to ensure the reliability, recoverability, and optimum performance of user hardware and local services.
* Work in tandem with the rest of the IT Operations team to uphold system SLAs with a rotating On\-call schedule for production support issues.

 Seeking a customer\-focused IT Support Associate who excels in Windows/Mac/Linux OS deployment, remote technical support, and comprehensive user hardware/software/peripheral assistance, while demonstrating expertise in LAN troubleshooting and hardware asset management. This role requires someone who combines strong technical capabilities with genuine curiosity, commitment to team success, and an initiative in delivering hands\-on IT support across all platforms.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
